goblin-warren.name: Goblin Warren
goblin-warren.summary: A stinking burrow under the Whisperwood. Kill the pack, loot the hoard.

rooms.name: Warren Mouth
rooms.description: A low dirt tunnel yawns under roots. Bones and chicken feathers litter the mud. Deeper in, something snickers.

rooms.name: Sleeping Den
rooms.description: Crude nests of stolen cloaks. A firepit smolders. The air reeks of grease and wet dog.

rooms.name: Stolen Hoard
rooms.description: A hollowed chamber piled with cracked crates and a locked chest. Boot prints everywhere.

bone-crypt.name: Crypt of Loose Bones
bone-crypt.summary: A collapsed barrow east of the waystone. Undead shuffle in the dark.

rooms.name: Crypt Steps
rooms.description: Stone stairs sink into chill air. Names on the walls are worn smooth. Something scrapes ahead.

rooms.name: Ossuary Hall
rooms.description: Shelves of skulls line the walls. Dust motes hang in your light. Footfalls echo twice.

rooms.name: Sealed Tomb
rooms.description: A cracked sarcophagus and a iron-bound coffer. The air tastes of old incense and rot.

bandit-hollow.name: Bandit Hollow
bandit-hollow.summary: Outlaws camping in a ravine north of the gate road. Coin and steel for the bold.

rooms.name: Hidden Trail
rooms.description: Brush parts on a narrow path. Fresh boot prints and a snapped tripwire mark a camp nearby.

rooms.name: Bandit Camp
rooms.description: Tents, a cookfire, and a weapon rack. Lookouts whistle when strangers approach.

rooms.name: Stash Cave
rooms.description: A damp cleft stuffed with crates. The captain's lockbox sits on a flat rock.
